'''Stonehill Industries''' was the manufacturer of the [[Asteroid ship (Stonehill Industries)|Asteroid ship]].

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Stonehill Industries was named by author [[Timothy Zahn]] after the Stonehill Science Fiction Club of Tampa, Florida.<ref name="HTTE20">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>
